angle: Clarify lease impact on flat value
body_text:
𝐇𝐃𝐁 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐲…

👉 𝐈𝐬 𝐢𝐭 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐚 “𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐛𝐨𝐦𝐛”?
Or just something most owners haven’t fully reviewed?

Many homeowners hear about it.
But few understand how it actually affects their options.

𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐧:

🏠 How remaining lease affects your flat’s value
📊 What it means for buyer demand over time
💰 Your estimated cash proceeds
🔁 When upgrading may (or may not) make sense

No jargon. No pressure. Just a clear breakdown.

👉 𝐆𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐇𝐃𝐁 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐝𝐞
